# ISONH

Website: https://www.isonh.2bd.net/

> ISONH is an online education platform ("Education Beyond Borders") offering affordable, practical courses. Learners buy a course by messaging the team on WhatsApp.

## Courses

- HSC ক,খ – 650 BDT: structured preparation for HSC ক and খ, self-paced, with direct WhatsApp support.
- Ethical Hacking – 700 BDT: cyber security fundamentals and hands-on practice, starting from zero.
- HSC Academic – 1000 BDT: complete HSC academic syllabus preparation in one place.

## How to enroll

1. Open the home page and go to the Courses section.
2. Press "Buy Now" on the chosen course. WhatsApp opens (+8801617926055) with a ready message naming the course and its price.
3. Send the message. The team replies with payment and enrollment instructions.
